meta2.speaking: 3 parts · answers are recorded · scored by AI

ruleIelts1: The Listening audio plays once. You can’t pause or replay it.
ruleIelts2: Sections run in order: Listening, Reading, Writing.
ruleSat1: Module 2 adapts to how you did in Module 1.
ruleSat2: You get a 10-minute break between Reading and Writing and Math.
rule3: The timer keeps running if you leave fullscreen. Leaving more than 3 times ends the section.
rule4: Answers save automatically. If you lose connection, keep going — the timer keeps running, as in the real exam, and your answers are sent when you are back online.
rule5: Once you submit a section you can’t return to it.
